tagline: Schedule sprint ceremonies from Jira milestones and add those events directly to your calendar
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Jira Integration: Milestones as Events
metaDescription: Schedule sprint ceremonies from Jira and add milestone due dates to Google Calendar. GAIA updates events when dates move. See the setup steps.
intro:
Sprint plans, milestones, and release dates live in Jira, but those dates rarely appear automatically in the calendar tool your entire organization uses to schedule meetings and block time. Engineers and project managers end up manually creating calendar events for sprint ceremonies, release dates, and milestone reviews — work that is error-prone and quickly goes stale when the dates change.

GAIA connects Google Calendar and Jira so your project timeline is always reflected in your calendar. Sprint start and end dates become calendar events automatically. Milestone due dates appear as all-day events with the right context. Release dates block time in the relevant engineers' calendars. When a sprint date changes, GAIA updates the corresponding calendar event so everyone stays aligned without manual re-entry.

This integration is essential for engineering teams who use Google Calendar as their primary scheduling tool and treat their issue tracker as the project management source of truth, particularly where coordination with non-engineering stakeholders requires calendar visibility of development milestones.

useCases.title: Auto-schedule sprint ceremonies from Jira
useCases.description: GAIA reads the sprint dates and automatically creates calendar events for sprint planning, daily standups, sprint review, and retrospective on the correct days with the right attendees.

useCases.title: Add milestone due dates to Google Calendar
useCases.description: When a milestone or version release date is set, GAIA creates an all-day calendar event so the milestone is visible to everyone in the organization who relies on the calendar for scheduling.

useCases.title: Update calendar events when Jira dates change
useCases.description: If a sprint is extended or a milestone is rescheduled, GAIA automatically updates the corresponding events and notifies attendees so the calendar stays accurate without manual correction.

useCases.title: Block focus time around release dates
useCases.description: GAIA detects upcoming release dates and blocks focus time in engineers' calendars in the days before the release, protecting time for final testing and bug fixes without requiring a manual calendar update.

useCases.title: Create issues from calendar events
useCases.description: When a planning meeting or design review is added to the calendar, GAIA can create a linked epic or story to capture the deliverables discussed, connecting scheduling to project tracking.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize both accounts in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses OAuth for Calendar and Jira's REST API to access the projects and calendars you specify.

howItWorks.step: Choose which projects and event types to sync
howItWorks.description: Select the projects whose sprint dates and milestones should appear on the calendar. Configure which calendar to use for each project and how far in advance events should be created.

howItWorks.step: GAIA creates and maintains calendar events automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for sprint and milestone date changes and keeps the corresponding events in sync automatically. You can also ask GAIA for a calendar view of any project's upcoming dates.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync a two-week sprint cycle to repeating Google Calendar events?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create recurring events that match your sprint cadence. When a sprint's actual dates deviate from the recurrence, GAIA updates the specific instance without affecting the broader series.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support Jira Software and Service Management?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports sprint and milestone syncing natively for the Software edition. SLA-based calendar events from the Service Management edition are also supported, creating calendar reminders for key SLA milestones.

faqs.question: Can I sync project dates to a shared team calendar instead of personal calendars?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to write events sourced from the project to a shared calendar that the whole team has access to, providing a single team calendar that always reflects the current project timeline.
